preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to change _adminWalletAddress
Contract must have accumulated tokens >= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity to trigger swapAndLiquify

exploit_hint: 1. Acquire owner role of the contract. 2. Call _setReceiverWallet() to set _adminWalletAddress to attacker's address. 3. Trigger token transfers to accumulate tokens in contract balance >= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity. 4. When swapAndLiquify() is automatically triggered during transfers, it calls sendBNBToAdmin() which transfers ALL contract BNB balance to _adminWalletAddress (now attacker's address). 5. Attacker receives drained BNB funds.
